coaching.headline: Nine won fights to three carried the game; the enemy took Mini Prime, Orb Prime and Primal Fangtooth and still lost all three inhibitors.

flags.text: Lt. Belica led the game in hero damage, 80,662, and razed the mid outer, inner and inhibitor.
TwinBlast farmed the hell out of Drongo: six of Drongo's eleven deaths.
Serath's eleven kills came at 865 hero damage a minute against a 566 norm.
The damn early majors went enemy: Mini Prime and the first Fangtooth both fell before any allied major.

focus.title: Contest the early neutral objectives
focus.action: When Mini Prime or Fangtooth is the next objective and all five are alive, group at the pit and contest; with two allies down, concede the Prime and hold the next tower.

26.call: Won 3-0: Lt. Belica killed Neon on mid, and Serath and TwinBlast killed Phase and Drongo on the duo lane, then Fangtooth went allied. Clean conversion; repeat the order.

30.6.call: Won 2-0: Serath killed Kwang in the allied jungle and Lt. Belica killed Phase on mid, then Mourn razed the enemy offlane outer and Fangtooth went allied. Chain the next tower the same way.

44.4.call: Won 3-2: Lt. Belica's kill on Neon came first, TwinBlast and Lt. Belica razed the duo and mid inhibitors, and Mourn killed Drongo and Phase in the enemy jungle. Stay grouped for the third inhibitor.

57f26d66-a5e5-4c19-a166-bed7a9450648: Seven deaths, 87% over the norm, and four went to Kaelen on the offlane and at the Prime pit. When Kaelen shows, step off Rimeglass and leave Frostfall's landing center.
Game-high 110,413 damage mitigated and 50,561 healing, plus kills on Drongo and Phase during the inhibitor fight. On grouped pushes, keep taking the front.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Vision carried: 23 wards against a 13.4 norm, 44,789 healing and 51% kill participation. In long games, hold the same ward pace through the late objectives.
Drongo took three of four deaths, all on the duo lane, two before minute ten. Dodge Gag Grenade's silence and engage only after Shrapnel Cannon is spent.
The kill on Kaelen came first in the closing fight, before the offlane inhibitor and the Core fell. With the enemy jungler dead, call the base push on the spot.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Team-high 16,749 objective damage, and the duo inhibitor razed during the inhibitor fight. After every won duo fight, hit the nearest standing tower before farming camps.
Two duo-lane deaths to Drongo before minute ten, one outside any detected fight. Early in lane, take trades on Drongo only when the support can follow up.
101e03d9-3e67-4540-ac65-2508d31c1a1c: A single assist all game, the fewest on the team. Before a gank, ping the target so the laner commits alongside the jungler.
Deaths on mid to Kaelen and Neon came before enemy Primal Fangtooth and Orb Prime. With either objective next, take mid fights only when the duo can join.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Rotation kills on Drongo landed on the duo lane and the offlane; the offlane kill preceded Mourn razing the enemy offlane outer. Keep rotating whenever mid goes quiet.
Both deaths came late on mid, each within seconds of this midlaner's own kill. After a late kill, back off to the team before taking the next trade.
Cleared four of the team's six destroyed enemy wards. If the sentry is equipped, sweep the approach to each objective pit before the team commits.

ourKits.combo: Abduct to pull a target in, Beguile to Mesmerize the group, Contagion to heal allies and shred enemy armor, and Eclipse to blind the enemy team's vision and spread Contagion map-wide.
ourKits.winCondition: Pull a target into his team with Abduct, lock the fight with Beguile and keep allies healthy with Contagion.
ourKits.passive: Extract: his next basic attack cleaves for bonus damage and restores health.
ourKits.playWith: Burst damage that punishes his pulled or Mesmerized target and benefits from the armor shred.
ourKits.playAgainst: Abduct and Beguile are both visible channels that slow Mourn, so sidestep the vines and walk out of the growing Beguile radius before it erupts. Anti-heal blunts Contagion and Extract.

ourKits.combo: Maco Fly! to slow and shield himself, Maco Sparkle! from range for a longer stun, Maco Gift! to heal allies or damage enemies, then a fully charged Maco Strike!
ourKits.winCondition: Land long-distance Sparkle! stuns and charged Strike! pushes while healing and speeding up allies with Gift!
ourKits.passive: Mach Speed! builds movement speed while moving and grants slow immunity at full stacks, lost when hit by heroes.
ourKits.playWith: A roaming, pick-oriented team that can follow his stuns.
ourKits.playAgainst: Hit him to remove Mach Speed! stacks. Maco Sparkle! is slow-moving and stuns longest at range, so sidestep it or close the distance; dodge the charged Strike! line.

ourKits.combo: Vortex Grenade slow → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate barrage
ourKits.winCondition: weave abilities for Gunslinger triple-shots and keep Rocket Dash up by hitting heroes
ourKits.passive: casting an ability grants attack speed and makes the next basic fire three times
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that creates space for him to keep shooting
ourKits.playAgainst: Rocket Dash is his only escape and comes back faster when he hits heroes, so engage right after he uses it; Ventilate is a short channel worth interrupting

ourKits.combo: Ascend to dive onto the backline, Chastise to slow and reset her basic attack, Heaven's Fury to go untargetable and strike, then Heresy for speed, attack speed and true-damage burns.
ourKits.winCondition: Dive the backline, get the first takedown and chain free Heresy activations from Fallen Grace.
ourKits.passive: Fallen Grace: hero takedowns drop a visage that, when touched, activates Heresy for free and cuts her basic ability cooldowns.
ourKits.playWith: A frontline that creates her dive angle and CC that holds targets for her.
ourKits.playAgainst: Do not waste CC or burst during Heaven's Fury, since she is invulnerable then; hit her as she lands from Ascend. Deny the first kill so she cannot pick up the visage.

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

enemyKits.combo: Cast basic abilities to build 3 Thread, then Overclock Data Burst to slow and Mesmerize, follow with L.I.N.X true damage and an Erase Vector dash into the exploding Jolt; Final Thread Overclocks everything and its recast bomb finishes low targets.
enemyKits.winCondition: Chunk enemies with Overclocked abilities in lane and teamfights, then use Final Thread to chain several Overclocked casts and execute with the bomb.
enemyKits.passive: Neural Network: every 3 basic ability casts Overclock her next basic ability for an extra effect.
enemyKits.playWith: Frontliners or engage supports who keep enemies in Data Burst range and give her time to cycle Thread.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Watch her Thread count and respect the next ability when she is at 3, since Overclocked Data Burst Mesmerizes. Dodge the lobbed Data Burst before it detonates, and engage after Erase Vector is spent, which is her only dash. Magic armor helps but L.I.N.X return and pulse are true damage.

enemyKits.combo: Judgement of the Heavens to tether, Surge of the Heavens into the Blade to knock up and stun, Light of the Heavens for true damage at the Blade, Fury of the Heavens to teleport and slow.
enemyKits.winCondition: Tether a target with the Blade, knock them up by dashing into it, and brawl with Energized basics that cut his cooldowns.
enemyKits.passive: Strike of the Heavens Energizes his basics after ability hits, adding attack speed, lightning damage and cooldown reduction.
enemyKits.playWith: Follow-up damage while he tethers and knocks up.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Watch where the Blade lands: it tethers, Surge into it knocks up, and Fury teleports him to it. Move away from the Blade and fight after Surge is used.

enemyKits.combo: Telekinetic Link a carry, Psychic Flare around both of you to blind enemies facing it, Energy Lance to stack slows into a root, and Hyperflux to give both of you attack speed, ability haste and speed.
enemyKits.winCondition: Power up a linked carry with the Link and Hyperflux and keep them healthy with Essence Catalyst healing.
enemyKits.passive: Essence Catalyst: abilities heal her and her linked ally over time, and her Phase Blink has a shorter cooldown and boosts her damage.
enemyKits.playWith: The strongest carry to Link, ideally one who wants attack speed and ability haste.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Turn away from Psychic Flare, since it only blinds enemies facing it, and break Energy Lance's beam before it reaches the root. Anti-heal cuts the shared healing; focus the linked carry or force the Link out of range.

enemyKits.combo: Rimefang to stun, slow and lay Rimeglass, Winter's Pursuit onto the Frostbitten target to root them, Razorstorm on Rimeglass, then Frostfall to crash down and root the center.
enemyKits.winCondition: Fight on his Rimeglass, where Razorstorm boosts his armor and Frostbite deals max health true damage and sets up Winter's Pursuit roots.
enemyKits.passive: Heart of Ice makes his abilities leave Rimeglass that slows and burns enemies with Frostbite.
enemyKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow up on his roots and Frostfall.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Step off Rimeglass so Frostbite ends before Winter's Pursuit can root you. Frostfall channels before he leaps, so move out of the center of the landing and leave the Rimestorm; tenacity helps against the roots.

enemyKits.combo: Old Rusty slows on the way out and back, Gag Grenade silences, Rad Rounds stacks Irradiate on basics, then Shrapnel Cannon shreds armor and erupts Irradiate
enemyKits.winCondition: kite from range, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, and use Shrapnel Cannon to shred or escape
enemyKits.passive: critical strikes and ability hits apply a max-health bleed
enemyKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Gag Grenade's silence; Shrapnel Cannon cast in the air launches him away and is briefly unstoppable, so engage after it is used; armor blunts his physical damage

bullets: Basic attacks built Lightning Hawk's Momentum, stacked Plasma Blade's critical strike chance on heroes and cut healing with Tainted Rounds; Rad Rounds' attack speed added more hits.
Weald fired true-damage projectiles at heroes Drongo hit below 30% health, on a per-hero cooldown; Dryad's Boon trimmed basic ability cooldowns with each basic attack hit.
Imperator added 30% to critical strikes, which also applied Wastelander's bleed; Wind-Rider's attack speed needs a dash, leap, teleport or stealth exit first.
Razorstorm hits every 0.25s, so Earthshaker's ability damage bonus stacked quickly, twice as fast for a melee hero, while Tainted Blade cut healing on every target.
Knell put Rust on heroes with each attack and ability, shredding both armors and handing Kaelen part of the shred, adding to Citadel, Basilisk and Aegis Of Agawar.
Patina shielded Kaelen and added movement speed after a stretch without taking damage; Resonant Repair restored health and added tenacity whenever Kaelen was immobilized.
Extract restores a share of Mourn's maximum health on damage, so Krix's bigger health pool, grown further by Cannibalism takedowns, made every Extract heal larger.
Voracity restored a sliver of maximum health and added gold on each unit kill, alongside Cybernetic Drive's execute and heal on minions and small monsters when ready.
Tainted Guard cut healing and bled any attacker landing basic attacks on Mourn, while Fist Of Razuul empowered a basic attack after a few seconds of trading damage.
Kwang's 4 area abilities spread Megacosm's damage over time to several heroes per cast; Caustica added damage on heroes above 50% health; Flux Matrix raised magical damage taken.
Vesh added damage over time on top of each ability hit on heroes, and Lich gave magical lifesteal, so Kwang's magical damage also restored health.
After Fury of the Heavens, Phylactery briefly sped up cooldowns and gave a max-mana shield, on a separate cooldown; 65 ability haste brought Fury back 39% sooner.
Maco Gift! heals allies or Maco, and each heal or Vortex Stone shield set off Exarch, giving that target attack speed and bonus magical damage on basic attacks.
Fervour healed Maco and nearby allies on basic attacks against heroes; Elafrost and Crescelia empowered a basic attack after casts, on short cooldowns; Preservation boosted healing Maco received.
Stuns from Maco Sparkle! and Maco Strike! set off Vortex Stone when ready, cutting current basic ability cooldowns by 20% and shielding Maco, a shield Preservation enlarged.
Ability hits fired Combustion when off cooldown and marked heroes for Noxia's burst on a second ability's hit; Caustica helped above 50% health, Wraith Leggings below 40%.
Aion's mana regeneration per cast and Void Bomb's mana refund per enemy hit kept mana high, which Runic Focus turned into more magical power.
Aion also paid gold for spell damage on heroes, and Bottomless Vial gave a potion charge plus permanent magical power for each river buff kill.
